library-room.prompt: Unsettling paranormal horror ambience. Reversed ghostly whispers, a faint child humming far away, nails scraping slowly on wood, low metallic groans, irregular creaks very close, a dark pulsing drone that rises and falls, sudden quiet moments then a distant heavy thud. Eerie, cursed and deeply uncomfortable. No melody.

witch-reveal.prompt: Horror movie witch reveal sting. Half a second of sudden held-breath silence, a fast reversed whoosh rushing in, then at about one second a massive deep cinematic boom with a dissonant screeching string stab and shattering glass, followed by a raspy distorted witch cackle echoing through a stone hall and a long eerie reverb tail fading to silence.
